scripts.check: npm run check:worklet && npm run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --project apps/frontend/tsconfig.app.json --pretty false && tsc --noEmit --project apps/frontend/tsconfig.node.json --pretty false
scripts.build: npm run build:static && npm run build:v17
scripts.build:static: node scripts/clean_v17_assets.mjs && tsc --project tsconfig.worklet.json && node scripts/copy_wake_assets.mjs
scripts.build:v17: npm run typecheck && node scripts/clean_v17_assets.mjs && vite build --config apps/frontend/vite.config.ts
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:node && npm run test:v17
scripts.test:node: node apps/frontend/tests/test_protocol.mjs && node apps/frontend/tests/test_extensions.mjs && node apps/frontend/tests/test_hands_free.mjs
scripts.test:v17: node apps/frontend/scripts/verify-syntax.mjs && vitest run --root apps/frontend tests/unit && node apps/frontend/scripts/verify-design-lock.mjs
